table: Figure 11 (average rating, post-monetization giveaways); simple aggregate printed in results/demand/demand-log.txt
replication_status: exact (did::att_gt with the authors' settings on the panel extracted from their fitted object: -0.5225599; the spec-field representation (never-treated controls, universal base, reg) gives -0.5225599; scratchpad/meta4/v01390_did.R/.csv)
notes: Authors' did::att_gt(yname avg_r_yearmon, tname ym_num, idname focal_book_id, gname giveaways_ym_num, control_group nevertreated, anticipation 0, allow_unbalanced_panel TRUE, clustervar focal_book_id) on post-monetization giveaway books plus similar never-giveaway books (demand_data_cleaning_code.R line 369). Panel extracted from postmon_attgt_simcontrol.gz: 455,433 book-months with at least one rating, 30,878 ids (21,747 treated + 9,131 never-treated), 27 cohorts, 51 periods, unbalanced. Re-aggregating the shipped object reproduces -0.52256 (analytic SE 0.0086; authors' 0.0082 is bootstrap). gvar = giveaway month (first treated period = giveaway month, as in the authors' call). The pre-monetization counterpart (premon_attgt_simcontrol) is missing from the package and its inputs are not shipped. AUTHORS' CSA SETTINGS (PROTOCOL 5b Hull alignment (c), Nov 2; demand_data_cleaning_code.R lines 301-376, 02_demand_results.R lines 400-457): did::att_gt(control_group = 'nevertreated', allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, est_method dr, base_period varying), aggte(type = 'simple', na.rm = TRUE). csa_control_group = 'nevertreated'. Hull default (not-yet-treated, no anticipation) on the original panel gives -0.5801. TIMING: the paper's TWFE (Table 4, spec T4vol_c2_post_giveaway) starts treatment the month AFTER the giveaway (post_giveaway = 1(yearmon > giveaway_yearmon)), whereas the CSA (gname = giveaway month) treats the giveaway month as the first treated period; this spec's constructed TWFE follows the CSA timing, so it is not comparable to the published Table 4 TWFE.
published_source: Shown only in Figure 11 of the published article; the main text prints no number for the rating effect, and Web Appendix Table 12 (online supplement, outside the article) prints -0.5226 (0.0082). No printed value. Authors' code output in authors_code_*. Read Nov 4 2026. Earlier: Authors' results/demand/demand-log.txt simple aggregate -0.5226 (bootstrap SE 0.0082). The article's main text reports only the pre-post difference (-0.08 stars, Section 4.5.1) and refers to Web Appendix Table 12 for the level; Figure 11(a) plots the dynamic ATTs. The level is therefore not printed in the main text (see log, open problem).
csa_weights_note: Nov 2: the published CSA comes from R did (or staggered, whose estimates did reproduces), which weights cells by fixed cohort shares; Hull's DiD-averaging weights cells by treated-observation counts. 'did' reproduces the published number (main analysis, option B); the strict-Hull run (CSA_STRICT_HULL=1, option A) ignores this field.
